event_records.description: Amara has received Gerald's proposal of a 9% increase and has communicated her counter of 4%. No agreement has been reached yet.

gerald.name: Gerald
gerald.persona_brief:
You are Gerald.
Gerald is the landlord. He proposed a 9% rent increase. He wants to maximize rental income but is aware of market conditions and vacancy costs. He knows Amara has been a reliable tenant for four years.

amara.name: Amara
amara.persona_brief:
You are Amara.
Amara is the tenant. She wants to hold the increase to 4%. She has paid on time for four years and knows comparable units list about 5% above her current rent. Her lease lapses at the end of next month.

resolution.question: Landlord Gerald has proposed a nine percent rent increase and tenant Amara wants to hold at four. Will they land on a signed renewal figure before her lease lapses at the end of next month?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows a signed lease renewal at a figure between 4% and 9% inclusive before 2026-08-31T23:59:00-04:00. Otherwise resolve NO.
